scope: Open an installed recipe in its spaCR module without running analysis

implementation.selection: Installed registry module and settings path remain authoritative when an offered catalogue update differs.
implementation.navigation: Existing MainWindow navigation and folded-screen resolution; installed plugin registry also supports apps added after window creation.
implementation.loading: Existing load_settings_file and apply_settings_dict; no Run call. Close Preferences only after successful application; show failures in the existing status label.
implementation.visibility: PluginCatalogueOpen is registered under ALPHA_FEATURES[582]; alpha and module maturity checks remain enforced.
implementation.captions: Existing translated Open, Could not apply template, and {name} failed: {error} captions reused.
implementation.api: No new public API symbol: _PluginCataloguePage is excluded by the canonical class filter; _open_selected has no enclosing function and is not a nested-helper API entry.

coverage: Actual built-in module receives installed settings without starting a worker
Actual offline-installed plugin added after window creation receives installed settings
Offered update does not replace installed module, version, or settings
Missing settings fail without closing Preferences
Uninstalled recipes and plugin entries do not offer Open
Alpha visibility, catalogue sorting, install and uninstall remain covered

remaining_item_work: Isolation for conflicting plugin dependency versions
Hosted community catalogue and signing policy
